about:
Panhandle Woodworks LLC operates out of Navarre, Florida, where founder Rick began the business after discovering a passion for woodworking in his thirties. Having grown up helping his father with hands-on projects around the house, Rick initially built pieces for his own home before expanding to create custom furniture for others. The company remains a solo venture, with Rick noting that woodworking is a second job alongside his primary employment.

The shop produces custom furniture, cabinetry, and built-in pieces, handling both fabrication and installation. Projects range from stair gates and cabinet doors to bathroom vanities, dog crates, bunk beds, shelving, and commercial salon stations. Work is performed on a made-to-order basis, with no standardized product line or volume metrics disclosed.

Customers are primarily residential homeowners in the Navarre area, though the portfolio includes a commercial project for Kat House Hair Salon, where Rick built custom cabinets and hair stations. Testimonials highlight repeat business for items such as kitchen cabinet doors, vanities, and pet furniture.

Rick emphasizes a commitment to using the best available materials and backs all labor with a one-year guarantee. He pledges not to compromise quality for speed, provides realistic schedules, and operates on a satisfaction-based payment model where contracts are paid in full only when the finished work meets the client’s complete approval.
